description: This file defines a static class PngOpener responsible for reading and parsing PNG image data streams, validating headers, reading chunks, handling CRC checks, and decoding image data within the PDFsharp library.

methods.name: Open
methods.description: Opens a PNG stream with optional chunk visitor, returns a Png object after parsing and decoding the image data.

methods.name: HasValidHeader
methods.description: Validates the PNG header in the stream.

methods.name: TryReadChunkHeader
methods.description: Attempts to read a PNG chunk header from the stream.

methods.name: ReadImageHeader
methods.description: Reads and parses the IHDR chunk to extract image metadata.
